rag.description: PathNotExists checks that no file or folder is present at a path before a workflow continues. The path in onElement can come from macros or parameters, and relative paths resolve from the working directory. It keeps cleanup and precondition steps reliable, but an unreachable share also counts as missing.

qa.question: What does the PathNotExists assertion check?
qa.answer: It evaluates to true when neither a file nor a directory exists at the path supplied in onElement.

qa.question: Which paths does PathNotExists accept?
qa.answer: Absolute, UNC, and relative paths, including values built with macros. Relative paths resolve from the process working directory.

qa.question: Where can PathNotExists run in a G4 environment?
qa.answer: PathNotExists checks the file system of the machine that executes the automation, so it applies when the G4 Hub or worker and the automation share a machine or can both reach a shared location. Documentation: https://github.com/g4-api/g4-plugins/blob/main/docs/Assertions/PathNotExists.md Source: https://github.com/g4-api/g4-plugins/blob/main/src/G4.Plugins.Common/Assertions/PathNotExists.cs

qa.question: How should PathNotExists be used with network shares?
qa.answer: Pair it with PathExists on the share root, because an unreachable share is reported as a missing path and would otherwise pass.

qa.question: How is PathNotExists used in a rule?
qa.answer: Use the Assert plugin with argument {{$ --Condition:PathNotExists}} and set onElement to the path to check.

qa.question: What is the PathNotExists manifest version and author?
qa.answer: The manifest version is 4 and the author is Roei Sabag.

qa.question: How does the PathNotExists manifest summarize the assertion?
qa.answer: It asserts that no file or directory exists at the onElement path and accepts absolute, UNC, and relative paths.

qa.question: How does PathNotExists handle errors?
qa.answer: An empty onElement records an exception and evaluates to false. An unreachable share or denied access is reported as a missing path, so the assertion evaluates to true.

description: ### Purpose
Asserts that neither a file nor a directory exists at the path supplied in `onElement`.
It runs on the machine that executes the automation, so it applies when the G4 Hub or worker and the automation share a machine or can both reach a shared physical location.
### Key Features and Functionality
| Feature            | Description                                                                                           |
| File And Directory | Evaluates to true only when no file and no directory exists at the path.                              |
| Path Resolution    | Accepts absolute, UNC, and relative paths; relative paths resolve from the process working directory. |
| Dynamic Paths      | Accepts macros and parameters in `onElement`, such as a path stored in a session parameter.           |
### Usages in RPA
| Use Case             | Description                                                                                |
| Duplicate Prevention | Confirms that an output file does not exist yet so a run does not replace earlier results. |
| Lock File Check      | Confirms that a lock file is gone before a process starts.                                 |
### Usages in Automation Testing
| Use Case             | Description                                                                  |
| Cleanup Verification | Confirms that temporary files or folders were removed after a workflow step. |
| Precondition Check   | Confirms that a target path is free before a step creates it.                |
### Limitations
An unreachable network share or denied access is reported as a missing path, so the assertion evaluates to true.
Pair it with `PathExists` on the share root when reachability matters.

edge_cases: A directory at the same path fails the check
An empty path evaluates to false
annotations.expected_result: The assertion passes when session.lock no longer exists in C:\Automation\Temp.
annotations.notes: The literal path is checked on the machine that executes the automation. A file or a directory at the path fails the condition.

description: ### Assert that a temporary file was removed
Use the `Assert` plugin with the `PathNotExists` condition and set `onElement` to the file path.
The assertion passes when no file or directory exists at that path.

edge_cases: A file named output at the same path fails the check
The folder already exists from an earlier run
The path resolves from the process working directory
annotations.expected_result: The assertion passes when no output folder exists under the process working directory.
annotations.notes: The relative path is resolved before the check. Run it before a step that creates the folder.

description: ### Assert that an output folder is free before a run
Set `onElement` to a relative directory path resolved from the process working directory.
The assertion passes when the folder does not exist yet.
The file or directory path to check.
Absolute, UNC, and relative paths are accepted; relative paths resolve from the process working directory.
